description.summary: With a loud strum or bash of your instrument you let out a wave of sound from your position in all directions, changing to an inaudible tone as it spreads outwards.
description.value: With a loud strum or bash of your instrument you let out a wave of sound from your position in all directions, changing to an inaudible tone as it spreads outwards. When the sound finds a settlement of Hamlet size or larger it pings the location back to the bard, letting them know the directions and distance to the grouping of people. If this song finds several settlements within its range it tells the bard the details for each one. For every mile the song travels, the bard must spend 1 minute concentrating on the song, if they stop concentrating the song ends and does not travel its total range.
